steps.content: The sound of writhing flesh hisses beneath the crimson-black flame. In its light, Hypatia sees the dagger—the one that, not long ago, had missed her neck by half an inch.
If her memory serves her right...

steps.speaker: Fraser Assassin
steps.content: I will bring you back, alive or otherwise.

A cold light flashes, a silver arc stabbing for Hypatia's heart. Her Aurum Secretum intercepts with a piercing metallic shriek. At the same moment, the assassin's lowered hand snaps into a fist, unleashing a torrent of crimson-black sorcery directly at her core.

...The dagger was only a feint. This is the true attack: a deceptively simple, nearly unblockable sorcery. Hypatia forces the Aurum Secretum to expand, attempting to envelop it. A wave of corrosive stench explodes between them.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The Underground, sorcery, contamination resembling the Black Ring... Just like the hotel attacker. I know this signature. It's one of them... it's...

The image of the crimson mark in Adelaide's hand flashes through her mind. She remembers his desperate battle with sorcery against the Aurum Secretum Warriors, back when this power was new to him. And she remembers the terrible price each activation demanded.
Could it be him?!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No. More likely an associate. I was careless.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But it's manageable. I can handle this.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Right. I know this power!

Hypatia sidesteps the dagger, refusing to harden the Aurum Secretum into a shield. Instead, she wills it liquid, pooling the golden substance in her palm. Every physical strike is a feint; each sorcerous cast demands a cooldown. Her only chance is to seal the casting flesh before the sorcery activates.

She baits an opening and seizes it. Her hand snakes out, clamping over the assassin's left just as it tenses to cast the sorcery. The Aurum Secretum responds instantly, flowing from her palm to engulf the unborn sorcery. It extends, seals, and hardens into a transparent, shell-like prison. Within, the gathered crimson energy rots into inert blackness, extinguished.
Triumph surges through Hypatia. She's half-tempted to conjure a team of tiny, applauding Aurum Secretum figurines just to celebrate.

steps.speaker: Fraser Assassin
steps.content: ...Target... uncontrollable... then...
Another attack, but the assassin lunges past Hypatia. His target is no longer her body, but the marble deity statue poised on the roof ridge behind her.

His blade strikes the statue's base. A web of fractures explodes across the marble. The compromised statue groans, tilting precariously on the edge before beginning its deadly teeter toward the crowded street far below.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No! The people—!
The girl throws herself toward the roof's edge, the Aurum Secretum in her hands warping violently as she snags the falling statue.
Yet the marble weight is colossal, ruthlessly pulling her down.

steps.speaker: Fraser Assassin
steps.content: ...Dislocate the limbs, bring her back alive...
With the assassin looming over her, Hypatia strains to lift herself or conjure even a sliver of Aurum Secretum. But the marble weight is absolute, crushing her attempts into nothing.
Her gaze locks on the rising dagger, only to see the assassin jolt violently and fall, his body gone stiff. Over his motionless form, the bandaged man looks back at her, his face finally exposed.
Didn't I mention it was dangerous outside? You really should have gone home.

He raises a hand, and a blade of pure shadow shoots out from his palm. The thunderous explosion of shattering stone erupts beside her, stopping her heart. In the choking cloud of rock dust, the Aurum Secretum net—now free from the target—contracts into a sharp blade in her hand. She has time for one desperate strike before he closes in.

Gritting her teeth, the girl swings her only weapon with everything she has. Untrained, she feels her blade meet only air before her wrist is twisted with effortless force, the weapon torn from her grip.

As the dust settles, the pale bandages fall away, revealing the true face of the visitor from the Underground. His blood-red eyes meet hers, holding a calm gentleness worlds apart from the murderous intent she'd seen in them that night.
A mocking smile touches his lips.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: Oh my, careful now, little scholar... A friend of mine is quite fond of this face. If it gets marred, I'll have some difficult explaining to do.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: Lower your weapon. Researchers ought to value their lives more. Leave this one to me.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: At the very least, you can believe now that I'm not with these fanatical monsters, yes?
